rows.summary: Waaree Energies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of the 36th Annual General Meeting to be held on September 24, 2026 at 11:00 A.M. (IST).

rows.title: Updates
rows.summary: Waaree Energies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Consolidation of the Company's Manufacturing Facilities from Tumb & Nandigram to the Company's existing manufacturing facility at Chikhli, Gujarat'.

rows.title: Record Date
rows.summary: Waaree Energies Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Final Dividend  for the Financial Year 2025 - 26 is Friday, September 11, 2026.

rows.title: Retirement
rows.summary: Waaree Energies Limited has informed the Exchange about Retirement due to completion of first term of five years of Ms. Richa Goyal, Non - Executive Independent Director.

rows.title: Appointment
rows.summary: Waaree Energies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Ms Mona Bhide (DIN: 05203026) as an Additional Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. August 30, 2026.

rows.title: Outcome of Board Meeting
rows.summary: Waaree Energies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on Saturday, August 29, 2026.
